description: US mega-cap earnings: when a company reports, whether that date is confirmed or still an estimate, whether it prints before the open or after the close, the consensus EPS, and once it lands the reported EPS with the beat or miss. fresh.description: Not on Pro or Ultimate? Set this to true and this one call answers live for 5 credits. Left out, Free, Squawk and Starter get the answer an hour behind for 1 credit. Pro and Ultimate are live already, so it costs nothing extra there. No effect without a key.

symbol.description: One or more tickers, comma separated, like AAPL or AAPL,MSFT. Empty returns every name tracked.
